FINAL SQL:
SELECT AirportCode
FROM (
    SELECT a.AirportCode,
           COALESCE(d.dept,0) + COALESCE(r.arr,0) AS total_flights
    FROM airports a
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT SourceAirport, COUNT(*) AS dept
        FROM flights
        GROUP BY SourceAirport
    ) d ON a.AirportCode = d.SourceAirport
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT DestAirport, COUNT(*) AS arr
        FROM flights
        GROUP BY DestAirport
    ) r ON a.AirportCode = r.DestAirport
) sub
WHERE total_flights = (
    SELECT MIN(total_flights) FROM (
        SELECT COALESCE(d.dept,0) + COALESCE(r.arr,0) AS total_flights
        FROM airports a
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT SourceAirport, COUNT(*) AS dept
            FROM flights
            GROUP BY SourceAirport
        ) d ON a.AirportCode = d.SourceAirport
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT DestAirport, COUNT(*) AS arr
            FROM flights
            GROUP BY DestAirport
        ) r ON a.AirportCode = r.DestAirport
    )
);
